subject: general
question: The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) focuses on:

options.text: Developing industrial clusters in backward regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enhancing development in underdeveloped districts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) was launched by the Government of India in **January 2018**, under the aegis of NITI Aayog.
 
• It aims to transform **underdeveloped districts** by addressing key sectors such as health, education, agriculture, water resources, financial inclusion, and skill development.
 
• The programme focuses on **improving developmental indicators** in 112 identified districts across India, which are lagging in socio-economic parameters.
 
• ADP leverages **real-time monitoring** and ranking mechanisms to ensure progress and accountability in district-level development.
 
• It emphasizes collaboration among **central and state governments**, local administrations, and development partners to implement targeted interventions effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Indicators Under ADP:**

 
 
• Districts are ranked on **49 key performance indicators** across 5 themes: health and nutrition, education, agriculture and water resources, financial inclusion, and basic infrastructure.
 
• These indicators are aligned with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
 
 
• **Monitoring Mechanism:**
 
 
• Real-time data collection and monitoring are facilitated via the **Champions of Change dashboard**.
 
• Districts are ranked monthly based on their progress, fostering competition and accountability.
 
 
 
• **Collaboration:**
 
 
• ADP encourages partnerships between the **government, private sector, and civil society organizations**.
 
• It promotes sharing of best practices among districts to enhance the overall impact.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• ADP has contributed to **improved developmental outcomes** in targeted districts, including better health services, enhanced school infrastructure, and increased agricultural productivity.
 
• By focusing on grassroots-level interventions, it aims to reduce inter-district disparities and foster inclusive growth.
